name: agent-fold
author: agent-fold contributors
description: Bell in the Omarchy bar that surfaces pending coding-agent questions and permissions.

barWidget.description: Answer coding-agent questions and approvals from the bar, or mirror them while answering in the native CLI.

schema.label: Answer agent questions in
schema.description: Top bar lets you answer Claude and OpenCode questions here (Claude waits for the bar; OpenCode accepts whichever answer comes first). Claude CLI (applies to every agent) mirrors the question in the bar while the agent's own prompt owns the answer.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Show a system notification for each new permission, question, waiting reply, or finished turn.
